name: SHADOW_DECISION_PERSIST_JSON_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: SHADOW_DECISION_PERSIST_JSON_20261107 — the weekly shadow batch (lane
shadow-batch-generator-at-15-10) reported failed = 1 of 86 on 2026-11-01, and the one failure was
PARA: 'invalid input syntax for type json' on the decision_blueprints insert. One yfinance bar of
ninety had NaN high/low/close; _tech summed over it, so ATR/RSI/SMA50 were NaN; NaN is TRUTHY, so
the 'no ATR' / 'no support' gates passed and a staged ladder priced in NaN was built; json.dumps
wrote the bare token NaN and PostgreSQL rejected the row, taking the whole packet with it.
Three boundaries must hold: a non-finite bar is not a bar, a gate on a level asks for a FINITE
number, and every jsonb write goes through _pg_json. Plus: a ladder whose levels are not positive
is refused rather than published. Hermetic: synthetic fixtures, no DB, no network, no broker.
Pre-existing suite failures in test_shadow_batch/test_stage_c_job_runner are the hermetic DSN
guard refusing live connections and are identical on wt/live-integration-20261106.
